Key is unsupported: replacing router does not make its own MAC the client allowlist entry; security and radio compatibility also matter.
Adapted and corrected. RAM holds active work. More RAM reduces the need to page working data to slower storage in this scenario.
Adapted and corrected. VLANs separate Layer 2 networks logically. A configured trunk can carry several VLANs between switches.

Scenario retained. Ribbon prints first sheet; pressure produces multipart copies. The ribbon supplies ink. Replacing a worn ribbon may improve the top sheet, while paper type and printhead gap also affect multipart output. A laser printer does not strike through a form stack.
Adapted and corrected. The internal test page rules out individual PC print drivers. Use the exact model's approved drum-cleaning procedure.
Sentence is truncated and does not establish scaling behavior; covered by A049.
Adapted and corrected. The model-specific code supplies the missing evidence. Three beeps do not mean the same fault on every computer.
Adapted and corrected. Infrastructure as a Service supplies virtual compute, storage and networking. It does not by itself provide the migration procedure.
Adapted and corrected. The heat warning and blocked filter support a cooling problem. Follow the manual's filter-cleaning procedure.

Scenario retained. Trace an unlabeled copper run with compatible toner and probe. The generator puts a traceable signal on the cable; the probe detects it. Use tools rated for the circuit and follow instructions for live networks. Label both ends after identification. A toner does not certify Ethernet speed.
Primarily Core 2 authentication-factor taxonomy; excluded from this Core 1 deck.
Adapted and corrected. The supported SSD addresses storage latency while retaining the HDD. M.2 alone describes a form factor, not guaranteed speed.

Scenario retained. NFC operates at 13.56 MHz and supports close-range credential exchange. Devices are normally brought within a small fraction of an inch to around an inch for a tap. NFC may exchange a small payload or start a Bluetooth connection; it is not the best choice for sustained large-file transfers.
Adapted and corrected. Calibration maps touch coordinates to display coordinates. It applies only to devices that support the procedure; random drifting can have other causes.
Adapted and corrected. HDMI can carry video and audio. Select the HDMI audio output and check volume after connecting it.
Symptoms do not establish internet failure versus gateway/addressing issue; insufficient diagnostics.

Scenario retained. MDM supports policies, approved apps and remote wipe on enrolled devices. An organization can distribute settings and apps and enforce supported policies. Capabilities depend on device ownership, platform and enrollment type. Enrollment does not mean every personal detail becomes visible to IT.
Adapted and corrected. DSL uses telephone copper. POTS means Plain Old Telephone Service. A shared-line failure can affect both services.
Adapted and corrected. Only A meets both explicit resource requirements. The missing comparison exhibit is replaced with a complete text scenario.
Rote troubleshooting step ordering is explicitly outside the current exam objectives.

Scenario retained. Distributes requests across backend servers; verify health and algorithm. This can improve capacity and availability. Health checks help avoid failed servers. A load balancer does not automatically add servers; scaling must be configured separately.
White space alone cannot distinguish layout, media, imaging or feed problems.
Adapted and corrected. The output wattage is inadequate for the measured load. A supported 115 V input is not itself the problem.

Scenario retained. Digitizer detects touch input; display produces image. The digitizer turns touches into location data. Check supported calibration, driver and settings first. Inspect hardware and connections if appropriate. A working image does not prove the touch layer works, and not every screen supports manual calibration.
Adapted and corrected. Measured service tracks consumption. The contract determines billing, which may also include fixed fees or commitments.
No workload or budget measurements justify one 15000 rpm disk over a redundant array.

Scenario retained. Hold jobs until authenticated release to reduce abandoned prints. A PIN, badge or authenticated release can hold the job until the user arrives. This protects physical pickup; it does not automatically encrypt every network transfer or stored copy.
Stem is truncated and missing the symptom.
DDR3 is not a universal modern desktop recommendation; platform compatibility is unspecified.
Adapted and corrected. The long signal path causes substantial propagation delay. A faster download plan or a modem restart cannot remove that distance; low-Earth-orbit service differs.

Scenario retained. Guests require logical separation plus guest and host security. Limit shared folders, clipboard, device access and network connectivity for risky testing. A VM escape is a breach from guest to host. Do not assume running malware in any VM makes it harmless.
Multithreading is not hardware virtualization; none of the listed options reliably solves this.

Scenario retained. Another application may hold the camera; close it and retry. Also check any privacy shutter or switch. For an external webcam, confirm the USB connection. If every app fails, test the driver and hardware path. One app failure is not proof of a damaged camera.

Scenario retained. Use isolated test environment; a VM alone is not a complete security boundary. Limit shared folders, clipboard, device access and network connectivity for risky testing. A VM escape is a breach from guest to host. Do not assume running malware in any VM makes it harmless.
Adapted and corrected. The firmware and old driver are incompatible in this stated case. Install the supported matching driver on the print server.

Scenario retained. Inspect indicated paper path safely; allow hot fuser to cool and follow manual. Pull paper in the instructed direction to avoid damage. A manual-feed prompt may instead mean the job requests another tray or size. Do not bypass a sensor to make the warning disappear.
Adapted and corrected. 1000BASE-T uses all four pairs and was designed for suitable Category 5 cabling. Damage or negotiation can cause a slower link.
No data-preservation-first answer is provided; stressing a failing unbacked-up drive with diagnostics is poor advice.
Same cable works on a test laptop, which narrows the issue to the workstation but does not prove its NIC is faulty.

Scenario retained. Ask what changed and establish symptoms before replacing hardware. A driver lets the OS communicate with hardware. Use the manufacturer or approved update source. A targeted rollback or supported update may help; replacing hardware without testing the software cause is premature.

Scenario retained. A faint visible image with illumination failure points to backlight path. LCD means Liquid Crystal Display. Many current LCDs use LED backlighting; some older CCFL-backlit displays use an inverter. Do not prescribe an inverter replacement for every dim modern screen. Check brightness settings too.
Error message absent and beep meanings are vendor-specific; no defensible pair.

Scenario retained. Select matching monitor input and verify video cable/path. The display can have power while receiving no usable signal. Test with a known-good cable or source to narrow the fault. A no-signal message alone does not prove a failed GPU.
Adapted and corrected. More RAM reduces paging; an SSD improves storage access. Neither change is justified by a database workload alone without checking the bottleneck.

Scenario retained. Prioritize recoverable data; minimize use and escalate irreplaceable data to recovery specialists. Repeated unnecessary use can worsen some failures. Check connections too, but do not assume a filesystem repair fixes mechanical damage. A current tested backup reduces the impact.
Core 2 removable-media encryption topic; also BitLocker To Go is a Windows feature, not installed on the stick.

Scenario retained. Enable automatic duplex in supported printer driver/settings. Automatic duplex hardware turns or routes the page internally; manual duplex asks the user to reinsert it. Choose the correct binding edge so the back side is not upside down.

Scenario retained. Capacity grows and shrinks with demand. Multi-tenancy means multiple customers use shared underlying infrastructure with logical separation. Keeping unnecessary capacity permanently allocated is overprovisioning, not the definition of elasticity.
Adapted and corrected. A loose USB connection interrupts the camera's data or power path. Check the simple physical fault before software changes.

Scenario retained. Web server responds to HTTP/HTTPS requests. HTTP means Hypertext Transfer Protocol. TLS means Transport Layer Security. HTTPS protects the connection; it does not prove that a site's claims are honest. HTTP/3 uses QUIC over UDP, commonly on 443.
Adapted and corrected. The measured interference and timing point to radio interference, not the internet provider or a hidden network name.

Scenario retained. Two mirrored 4 TB disks give about 4 TB usable and survive one disk loss; not a backup. Usable capacity is limited to roughly one member's capacity, assuming equal drives and ignoring overhead. Mirroring also copies unwanted changes, so a separate backup is still necessary.

Scenario retained. 802.11n introduced MIMO among listed standards; later Wi-Fi also supports it. Both ends must support the relevant features. MU-MIMO means Multi-User MIMO. Antenna count, channel width and stream count influence the link; they do not guarantee internet speed.
Adapted and corrected. Debris can obstruct key movement. Clean using the manufacturer's procedure; continued failures may require keyboard service.

Scenario retained. M.2 SSD plugs into motherboard slot; verify SATA/NVMe support. Match the electrical interface, keying and supported card length. M.2 2280 is about 0.87 by 3.15 inches; the name retains the standard's size code. A physically fitting drive may still be unsupported.
VT-d is I/O virtualization, not the general CPU virtualization prerequisite; VT-x/AMD-V is missing.

Scenario retained. ADF feeds multiple sheets; flatbed suits single or bound originals. It handles input pages. It is not the same as a printer's output duplexer. Check whether the particular ADF supports scanning both sides.
Adapted and corrected. Satellite can serve remote locations without a wired last-mile connection. Coverage, local rules and suitable terminal placement remain necessary.
Both network utilization and server disk health are plausible; no evidence picks a next step.
Adapted and corrected. A UPS supplies temporary battery power. It is one part of availability planning, not a guarantee of maximum uptime.
Adapted and corrected. The measured memory shortage justifies the RAM upgrade. File size or slow performance alone would not prove the cause.
Adapted and corrected. Inspect terminations and visible damage before replacing the entire run. This length is below the usual 328 ft channel limit; LED colors are model-specific.
Adapted and corrected. Quiet spectrum is not necessarily legal or supported spectrum. Hardware, regulatory rules and features such as radar detection affect channel availability.

Scenario retained. Managed runtime/development platform supports deploying app code. It supplies an application platform so developers can focus on code and data. The exact responsibility boundary depends on the service; it is different from renting a bare VM to administer yourself.
Adapted and corrected. A compatible Windows VM can run the application. Guest architecture, licensing and hardware support must match; this is not guaranteed for every Mac or application.

Scenario retained. eSATA is an external SATA interface; retained as explicitly listed legacy hardware knowledge. NVMe is designed for efficient access to nonvolatile storage such as SSDs. An M.2 SATA SSD does not become NVMe because it is small. Match the host interface and enclosure.

Scenario retained. FTP control uses TCP 21; active-mode data traditionally TCP 20; unencrypted without TLS. Passive mode uses a server-selected data port. Plain FTP does not encrypt credentials or files. SFTP is a different protocol carried over SSH, normally TCP 22.

Scenario retained. Mechanical HDD can click; SSD has no moving parts. Repeated unnecessary use can worsen some failures. Check connections too, but do not assume a filesystem repair fixes mechanical damage. A current tested backup reduces the impact.
Stem is truncated; no environmental evidence supports shielded cable.

Scenario retained. Normal picture with lost touch points to input path, subject to further diagnosis. The digitizer turns touches into location data. Check supported calibration, driver and settings first. Inspect hardware and connections if appropriate. A working image does not prove the touch layer works, and not every screen supports manual calibration.
Adapted and corrected. The model-specific diagnostic evidence identifies the fuser. Ghosting alone can also involve other imaging components.
Adapted and corrected. The qualification 'known destination' matters. Switches still flood broadcasts and unknown unicast frames within the applicable VLAN.
Adapted and corrected. The battery-health result supplies direct evidence. Stop charging and arrange safe service; heat or slowness alone would not identify the part.

Scenario retained. Authorized cellular hotspot can provide temporary connectivity where coverage permits. A hotspot commonly shares cellular service over Wi-Fi; tethering is the broader sharing idea. A compatible cellular modem is another option. Carrier plans, coverage and data allowances still apply.

Scenario retained. Verify CPU socket, chipset and firmware support; never force a CPU. A socket is the physical CPU connection. Check the motherboard's supported CPU list and required firmware version. Avoid forcing a processor or relying only on a family name such as Core i7.
Adapted and corrected. Excess heat darkens heat-sensitive media. Use the approved setting; this printer does not use an ink cartridge or ink ribbon.
Record sensitivity alone does not determine deployment model or attack surface.
Core 2 Windows management tool question; DiskPart also lists disks, so key is not unique.
Adapted and corrected. Use a compatible RJ45-style plug and the correct crimper. A wall jack may instead use a punchdown or tool-less termination.

Scenario retained. T568A and T568B swap orange and green pair positions, not throughput. A straight-through cable uses the same scheme at both ends. A and B swap the orange and green pair positions. Keep each pair correctly twisted and follow the connector's wiring guide.
Adapted and corrected. The backup battery maintains the real-time clock without external power. Follow the model's replacement procedure.
Adapted and corrected. Routing separates networks. A managed switch can also create broadcast domains with VLANs, so 'switches never separate broadcasts' would be wrong.
Adapted and corrected. A Personal Area Network connects a person's nearby devices. A cable used only for charging would not create a network.

Scenario retained. Direct thermal printing needs compatible heat-sensitive paper with correct orientation. A direct thermal printer does not require an ink ribbon. Wrong media, heat settings or a dirty head can affect output. Choose the method and approved media for the label's required durability.
Adapted and corrected. The external keyboard narrows the fault to the built-in input path, and visible debris supports cleaning before replacement.
Wording contradicts the intended availability goal; ambiguous privacy concern.

Scenario retained. Keyboard/video/mouse switch shares peripherals between computers. A KVM switch changes which computer receives those input/output devices. It does not combine the computers' CPU power or act as a general network switch.
Adapted and corrected. A SATA SSD fits the stated interface and has no spinning mechanism. A 15,000 rpm HDD is still mechanical, and a SAS SSD needs SAS support.

Scenario retained. Hypervisor creates/manages VMs and allocates host resources. A VM presents virtual hardware to a guest OS. A management interface that looks like a desktop app does not by itself determine the hypervisor type.
Adapted and corrected. Channel planning addresses radio contention. Merely choosing different channel numbers is insufficient if those channels overlap.
Exact duplicate (ignoring punctuation/formatting) of A024.
Adapted and corrected. F connectors terminate coaxial cable. Plenum describes a fire/smoke rating, not a connector geometry.
Adapted and corrected. A tone generator and probe help trace this unlabeled run to its patch-panel termination. A loopback plug tests an interface instead.
Adapted and corrected. RAM supplies working memory, the GPU handles graphics, and an NVMe drive supplies fast storage when supported. Accessories do not fill these missing roles.

Scenario retained. Traditional cable internet commonly uses coax for the final connection; access networks vary. WAN means Wide Area Network; LAN means Local Area Network. An analog phone needs a working phone service or compatible voice port, not an ordinary Ethernet jack.
Contradictory duplicate of A079; BitLocker is not the all-disk management console; Core 2 scope.
Adapted and corrected. Rapid elasticity lets capacity expand or contract as demand changes. Measured service tracks usage rather than adjusting capacity.
Spill risk alone does not establish workstations over thin clients or other form factors.
Adapted and corrected. Dimming the display reduces a major power load. Turning off an unused radio can also save power; turning radios on does not.

Adapted and corrected. The IP address identifies the printer, the mask defines its subnet, and the default gateway reaches other networks. A driver is installed on a client or server, not one of these IP values.

Scenario retained. Release/renew requests DHCP lease configuration. The client needs an address and network settings before it can communicate normally. DNS resolves names; DHCP supplies configuration. They perform different jobs even when one server runs both.
Rote methodology stage identification is outside current tested objectives.
Broadcast SSID without data does not prove reboot is the first remedy; check uplink and addressing.
Exact duplicate (ignoring punctuation/formatting) of A048.

Adapted and corrected. Connect the printer to that PC by USB and enable authorized printer sharing. The setup depends on host availability; it does not sense whether the manager is physically present.
Adapted and corrected. An Ethernet switch uses its MAC table for Layer 2 forwarding. This differs from routing IP packets between networks.
Adapted and corrected. DNS resolves the hostname. Test the hostname itself; ping does not accept a full UNC share path as a host name.
Adapted and corrected. A headset combines headphones and a microphone. A supported game controller provides game input without a keyboard.
Adapted and corrected. Channels 1, 6 and 11 are the conventional nonoverlapping set for this stated band and region.
Adapted and corrected. Measured service records resource consumption so the provider can apply the contract's usage charges.
Adapted and corrected. A reservation associates a client identifier with a lease address. This differs from typing a manual static address on each device.
Exact duplicate (ignoring punctuation/formatting) of A013.

Scenario retained. USB-C connector is reversible; shape alone does not specify features or speed. USB 2.0 is up to 480 Mbps; USB 3.2 modes include 5, 10 and 20 Gbps. Mbps and Gbps mean millions and billions of bits per second. The slowest supported link capability limits operation.
Adapted and corrected. Host-only networking normally lacks an external route. Configure the appropriate virtual network and guest addressing; bridged mode does not inherently require a static IP.
Legacy parallel ATA bus-width trivia not included in current Core 1 hardware outline; omit low-value obsolete detail.
Adapted and corrected. A router joins IP networks. A combined home gateway may also contain an access point and modem.

Scenario retained. Install model/OS-compatible vendor driver; generic driver may lack needed support. A driver translates print jobs into a format the printer understands. PCL means Printer Command Language. Different operating systems may need different supported drivers or driverless printing support.

Scenario retained. IPv4 link-local address commonly indicates no DHCP reply on an auto-configured client. APIPA means Automatic Private IP Addressing. It permits local-link communication without a DHCP lease. Routers do not forward it. Check the cable or Wi-Fi connection and DHCP service; it does not by itself prove the server is broken.
Adapted and corrected. Clear the affected stuck job or queue using the authorized procedure. A successful internal page makes a blanket printer hardware replacement premature.
Warning message omitted; evidence does not select exactly two remedies.

Scenario retained. Check signal cable and connections before replacing display components. The display can have power while receiving no usable signal. Test with a known-good cable or source to narrow the fault. A no-signal message alone does not prove a failed GPU.
Adapted and corrected. SMTP sends mail; IMAP reads it. Enable the required transport encryption rather than changing the mailbox retrieval protocol.
Adapted and corrected. Two DHCP services are supplying conflicting configurations. Identify and correct the unauthorized service rather than assuming DNS is the cause.
Adapted and corrected. Extended display mode enables the external screen as additional desktop space. Working USB ports alone would not prove video compatibility.
Adapted and corrected. Use a supported modern wireless security mode and strong passphrase, plus two-factor authentication for the cloud account. Original WPA is obsolete protection.
Unrelated failures and insufficient evidence; key cannot justify capacitor and battery diagnoses.
Adapted and corrected. Leave the required address on the desktop and give the laptop a unique DHCP lease. Confirm the static address is excluded from the DHCP pool.
Capacity need and growth are unspecified; cannot promise 3 TB lasts a year.
Adapted and corrected. The +5 V standby rail remains available for supported standby functions. A shut-down but plugged-in computer can still have energized circuits.

Scenario retained. USB can carry headset audio and microphone data. HDMI means High-Definition Multimedia Interface and can carry audio and video. The OS may still send sound to another output. A supported USB audio device is another sound interface, not a video-cable repair.
Adapted and corrected. Both 802.11a and 802.11ac use 5 GHz. The original single-answer key omitted ac; 802.11b and g use 2.4 GHz.
Adapted and corrected. An SSD improves local storage access; a second monitor adds visual workspace. Neither substitutes for adequate processing resources.
Adapted and corrected. A compatible docking station combines these connections. Verify that the host port, cable and dock support every required feature.
Adapted and corrected. Low free space and storage activity deserve inspection. The normal readings do not prove storage is healthy or justify leaving protection disabled.

Scenario retained. Drop while plugged in can damage charging connector or board; inspect safely. Test a compatible known-good cable and charger. Follow approved cleaning instructions; do not force metal objects into the port. A damaged port may need service, but the symptom alone does not identify the failed part.
Scenario retained. Wireless success with known-good wired charger points to wired charging path; inspect debris/damage safely.
Corrupted stem does not establish intended activity-tracking requirement.
Adapted and corrected. The stated power deficit supports an inadequate PSU. GPU load alone would not rule out overheating or other faults.
Adapted and corrected. POST codes vary by model. Interpret the observed pattern before choosing a replacement component.
Adapted and corrected. Protect recoverable data first. If the data is irreplaceable or the drive becomes unreadable, stop unnecessary use and consider professional recovery.
No universal KVM requirement; firewall management can use serial console, SSH or web interface.
Adapted and corrected. Turn off unused cellular and Bluetooth radios. Savings depend on hardware and workload, so no fixed improvement is guaranteed.
Adapted and corrected. A hybrid cloud combines distinct cloud infrastructures. Merely keeping some ordinary local files and some cloud files would not establish this model.
3D filament identification is absent from current printer maintenance objectives; filter legacy scope.
Adapted and corrected. Share the existing USB printer through the manager's computer and grant authorized users access. The host must remain available.
Adapted and corrected. Enable Bluetooth so the saved pairing can connect. If the pairing itself were lost, re-pairing would be a different repair.
Adapted and corrected. The virtual switch connects the guest's adapter to the intended network. Changing virtual RAM or CPU does not repair this path.
Adapted and corrected. Of these choices, 802.11n supports MIMO. Later Wi-Fi generations also support it.
Adapted and corrected. Rapid elasticity expands or contracts resources with demand. Resource pooling describes shared underlying resources, not the scaling action itself.
Core 2 installation task; remote SSH is missing from choices and repartitioning is unnecessary.
Adapted and corrected. Memory-test errors are stronger evidence than generic crashes. POST codes must be interpreted using the model's documentation.
More than three plausible causes; failed part is also valid, so key is not defensible.
Adapted and corrected. An online-only placeholder represents a cloud file without storing all its contents locally. Accessing it generally requires a download.

Scenario retained. Airplane mode may disable cellular and Wi-Fi; many devices allow Wi-Fi to be re-enabled. Airplane mode controls radios, but some systems let Wi-Fi or Bluetooth be turned back on separately. Verify actual radio settings. A phone may use cellular data when Wi-Fi is unavailable, depending on settings.

Scenario retained. Compatible charged battery pack/case extends runtime without wall power. W means watts, a power unit. A low-power charger or power bank may charge slowly or fail under load. USB Power Delivery negotiates supported power; the cable also needs the correct rating.
Adapted and corrected. Separate name lookup from connectivity. Browsing an HTTPS site by raw IP can fail for certificate or virtual-host reasons even when DNS is not the problem.

Scenario retained. Check adapter enabled and hardware/airplane-mode controls. Airplane mode controls radios, but some systems let Wi-Fi or Bluetooth be turned back on separately. Verify actual radio settings. A phone may use cellular data when Wi-Fi is unavailable, depending on settings.
Undefined LRSIMM and server-grade laptop premise; no supported module recommendation possible.
SSID does not explain intermittent kitchen interference; check RF conditions and band.

Scenario retained. RJ11-style connector commonly used for telephone line connections. WAN means Wide Area Network; LAN means Local Area Network. An analog phone needs a working phone service or compatible voice port, not an ordinary Ethernet jack.
Adapted and corrected. The host shares its locally attached printer over the LAN. It must stay powered on and reachable.
Adapted and corrected. A phone hotspot can share cellular data with the laptop when authorized and supported. NFC and a VPN do not supply an internet connection by themselves.
Adapted and corrected. An F connector terminates coax. RG-59 and RG-6 name cable types, not connectors.
Scenario retained. A static configuration from another subnet can prevent guest-network access; use authorized DHCP settings.
Adapted and corrected. RAID 10 combines striping and mirroring. It does not promise zero downtime, and backups remain necessary.
Budget and website/ERP labels do not determine PaaS versus SaaS/IaaS; management needs missing.
Thermal technology unspecified; direct thermal uses no ribbon; missing columns have several causes.
Adapted and corrected. The hypervisor provisions and manages virtual machines on the host. Disk Management alone does not create a complete VM environment.

Scenario retained. Local network within building is LAN; fiber does not make it WAN. A LAN serves a local site. A PAN links a person's nearby devices. A MAN spans a metropolitan area. A SAN provides networked storage access, commonly block storage; it is not merely a large office LAN.
Primarily Core 2 operational policy/authorization; retain no rote process card here.
Adapted and corrected. Password storage and recovery differ by model. Removing the RTC battery is not a reliable universal firmware-password reset.
Adapted and corrected. DHCP supplies configuration. Clients still need a working link and any required access authorization.
Adapted and corrected. Telnet normally uses TCP 23. Blocking TCP 21 targets FTP control, not Telnet; other remote-access services need their own policy.
Adapted and corrected. SSH commonly uses TCP 22 and HTTPS TCP 443. Secure operation still depends on the actual service and configuration.
Adapted and corrected. PXE is a network-boot path. Restore the intended local boot configuration after verifying the drive rather than inventing a PXE server address.
Adapted and corrected. Near Field Communication supports close-range contactless payment. The payment system still needs a supported device and credentials.
Adapted and corrected. Reproduce the failure on another workstation, then inspect relevant traffic and firewall logs. Do not blindly open ports.
Adapted and corrected. The correct service procedure identifies power isolation, cable routing and safe disassembly. Labeling alone cannot replace missing instructions.
Adapted and corrected. RAID 10 adds mirrored redundancy to striping. It does not guarantee faster performance than every RAID 0 system.

Scenario retained. Check power source, cable and switch first before internal replacement. PSU means Power Supply Unit. Verify simple external causes before opening the chassis. A dark system can have several causes; it is not automatic proof of a failed motherboard.
Rack protective-ground compliance measurement is beyond this Core 1 deck; unspecified test cannot certify grounding.
No GPU option and dual monitors not necessary; fixed CPU count cannot meet unknown games.
Unspecified existing OS/peripherals/apps prevents selecting exactly three required steps.

Scenario retained. Check DHCP scope/reservations/exclusions and static assignments for collisions. Each host needs a unique address on that subnet. Find which assignment is wrong, correct it, and keep manually assigned addresses out of the DHCP pool. Do not change a server's address without considering services that depend on it.
NIC, medium and switch may all be in path; topology unspecified and switch not mandatory.
Adapted and corrected. A mouse provides pointing input. A webcam captures images, which is a different kind of input.
Adapted and corrected. DDR generation, module form factor and ECC capability must all match. ECC is not an alternative generation to DDR4.
Adapted and corrected. Duplex printing uses both sides of a sheet. Collating controls the order of copies, not which side receives printing.

Scenario retained. 169.254.1.1 is IPv4 link-local; normally not routed off-link. APIPA means Automatic Private IP Addressing. It permits local-link communication without a DHCP lease. Routers do not forward it. Check the cable or Wi-Fi connection and DHCP service; it does not by itself prove the server is broken.
VR-headset key is wrong; e-paper sunlight readability is peripheral to current listed display technologies.
Adapted and corrected. ipconfig /flushdns clears cached name-resolution entries. It does not repair every DNS server or routing problem.
Contrast does not reliably repair lamp dimness; multiple possible causes and insufficient isolation.
Access-network architecture unspecified; several technologies change media before last mile.
Adapted and corrected. The identified constraint is RAM. Guest workloads and host overhead determine the required amount.

Scenario retained. Touchscreen can accept check-in input; protect kiosk appropriately. IoT means Internet of Things: network-connected physical devices such as sensors. A touchscreen can be a peripheral within a kiosk; the terms describe different aspects of the setup.

Scenario retained. Multiple compatible guests can share one adequately sized host for testing. Check guest support, licensing, hardware dependencies and security. A VM does not automatically make an old OS secure or make software for a different CPU architecture run natively.
Drive count absent and implausible spindle speeds; cannot derive capacity/performance/failure points.
Adapted and corrected. A compliant Cat 5e channel supports 1000BASE-T. The explicit prices make the cost comparison valid; Cat 5 is not inherently restricted to 100 Mbps.
Adapted and corrected. The device's memory error points to its page-processing capacity. Network speed does not supply printer RAM.
Adapted and corrected. DNS resolves the server name; it does not resolve the full share path as one DNS name.
Roller cleaning does not repair faint toner density; insufficient evidence for exactly two options.
No evidence distinguishes background updates from OS/app/storage causes.
Adapted and corrected. The media profile lets the printer choose supported feed and fusing conditions. Do not manually overheat the fuser.
Adapted and corrected. Each office uses a LAN. The city-wide interconnection is a MAN; these names describe scope rather than guaranteeing speed.

Scenario retained. Modern discrete graphics typically uses PCIe; verify slot, power, dimensions and firmware. A physical x16 slot may be wired for fewer lanes. Bandwidth also depends on the PCIe generation and both devices' support. Check the motherboard's lane-sharing rules.
Adapted and corrected. The SATA data connector carries storage traffic; the separate power connector supplies electricity.
Adapted and corrected. The link-local address suggests the client did not receive a DHCP lease. Because the PC was moved, first check its Ethernet connection and patching.
Adapted and corrected. Channel 6 is a standard 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi channel. For 20 MHz channels, 1, 6 and 11 are commonly used to avoid overlap.
Adapted and corrected. Use the sync application's bandwidth limit or schedule. Router QoS is a separate network-wide control, not the app's own setting.

Scenario retained. DHCP must provide valid DNS resolver settings for name resolution. The client needs an address and network settings before it can communicate normally. DNS resolves names; DHCP supplies configuration. They perform different jobs even when one server runs both.
Adapted and corrected. The common AP, its power, radio and uplink are a sensible next focus. Wired connectivity alone does not prove every DHCP or wireless path works.
Adapted and corrected. Rapid elasticity adjusts capacity with demand. Overprovisioning means allocating extra capacity and does not describe automatic scaling.

Scenario retained. Authorized VPN gives remote access to private network resources over untrusted networks. An encrypted remote-access VPN can protect traffic between a user and the VPN endpoint. It does not automatically protect traffic after that endpoint or make an unsafe device trustworthy.

Scenario retained. Authorized VPN gives remote access to private network resources over untrusted networks. An encrypted remote-access VPN can protect traffic between a user and the VPN endpoint. It does not automatically protect traffic after that endpoint or make an unsafe device trustworthy.
Adapted and corrected. An Intrusion Prevention System can enforce blocking. An IDS primarily detects and alerts; neither catches every attack.
Adapted and corrected. Power isolation reduces further damage. A supported inspection is needed before determining repairability or cost.

Scenario retained. Verify AC input range and local plug/cable suitability; never assume universal voltage. AC is alternating current; DC is direct current. Efficiency is not the percentage of labeled wattage you may use. A 750 W PSU is not reduced to 600 W merely because it is 80% efficient. Check the unit's label rather than assuming every PSU needs a manual voltage switch.
RAID, full storage and access/service failure remain possible; remote access alone is insufficient.

Scenario retained. Provider-hosted calendar application is SaaS. Users consume an application instead of maintaining its underlying server platform. They still manage their accounts, access choices and data responsibilities.
Adapted and corrected. Suitable optical fiber and optics can span this distance. An ordinary 328 ft copper Ethernet channel cannot bridge it directly.
Core 2 identity management; SSO does not universally eliminate device unlock passwords.
LCD inverter is not an established charging cause; arbitrary selection of three is unsupported.
